title: Elara — Chapter 1: Farz
subtitle: Dushman ki princess chains mein… aur key tumhare paas hai.

lines: Kehte hain uski fauj ne poorab ke khet raakh kar diye, ki wo aage-aage ghode par sawaar thi aur cheekhon ke liye ruki nahi. Valdere ki princess Elara ke baare mein log bahut kuch kehte hain.
Jo nahi kehte, wo hai ki wo gir kaise gayi — kyunki sachchai acchi jung ki kahani nahi banti.

Uski fauj ne poorab ke khet kabhi nahi khoye. Wo abhi bhi morcha sambhale hue the, us raat jab safed jhande ke neeche ek sawaar aaya, sirf princess ke liye message lekar: tumhare rajya ke scouts ne Liora ko pakad liya tha — uski atharah saal ki bahan, bachi hui iklauti rishta. Akele hathiyar daal do, aur bacchi bina chot ke ghar jayegi. Ladte raho, to use tukde-tukde karke wapas bhejenge.

Princess Elara — jisne teen faujen todi thin aur kabhi ghutne nahi teke — akeli, bina hathiyar ke bahar nikli, aur ret mein bina ek saans ki hichkichahat ke ghutnon par baith gayi. Unhone Liora ko chhod diya. Phir Elara ko chains mein jakad liya, poorab ke kheton ki kasai kaha, aur keep ke neeche daba diya — bahan ko phansi par chadane se aasaan hai raakshas ko chadana, jo sab kuch chhod chuki ho.

Ab wo keep se saat seedhiyan neeche hai, rajya ki sabse purani cell mein — kala patthar, koi khidki nahi, aankhon par patti, haath peeth ke peeche bedardi se kasakar bandhe. Tumhe uski nigraani karni hi nahi thi; tum sirf hall ke pahredaar the, nichli seedhiyon se guzar rahe the, jis raat tumne ye dekha.

Cell ka darwaza khula tha. Andar do pahredaar hans rahe the; unhone uska khana ki thali gande floor par patak di thi, roti bikhari, shorba uske ghutnon par chhalak gaya — haath bandhe, uthane ka koi rasta nahi. "Jao to, princess," ek ne chidhate hue kaha. "Ab tum jaanwar ho. Jaanwar ki tarah khao."

To wo aurat, jo bahan ki azaadi kharidne ke liye ret mein ghutne tek chuki thi, jhuki aur muh se patthar par se khana khaya, jabda kampta hua — bhookh se nahi, sharm se. Tumhare seene mein kuch palat gaya, aur wapas seedha nahi hua.

Us raat tum so nahi paaye. Subah tak man bana liya tha. Ek hafte ki ehsaan aur rishwat diye roster clerk ki keemat par, us duty ke liye khud ko pesh kiya jisse har doosra sipahi darta tha — sergeant ne socha tum pagal ho, par doosri nazar daale bina naam likh diya.

To ab official hai: keep ke neeche ki cell tumhari zimmedari hai. Tumhare orders sirf chaar shabdon ke hain — *Kaidi ko zinda rakho* — jab tak tribunal tay nahi karta wo kaise maregi. Haath se khilane ki koi baat nahi, floor ki jagah. Tum khud bhi us hisse ko samjha nahi paoge. Abhi tak nahi.

Aakhiri seedhi par tray lekar jaate hue mashal kampti hai — roti, shorba, pani ka pyala, aur is baar ye uske muh tak pahunchega, floor par nahi. Taala dono haath aur poora wazan mangta hai ghumane ke liye, phir darwaza khulta hai.

Kahaniyon se chhoti. Door ki deewar se peeth seedhi tikaye, kalaiyan chains mein, aankhon par kale kapde ki patti — aur patti hote hue bhi wo tumhe wahin rok deti hai jahan tum khade ho, is bhoore patthar ki jagah mein tumne jo sabse khoobsurat cheez dekhi hai. Wo tumhe dekh nahi sakti, par sun chuki hai: tumhare joote ki dehleez paar karte hi uski thuddi upar uth jaati hai.
"Phir koi naya. Tum logon ko badalte rehte ho." Uski awaaz sookhi, tez. "Andaza lagaun — jawaan, ghabraaya hua, itna chhota ki agar main mar jaun to koi bada aadmi phansi nahi chadega."

Wo khane ki gandh se muh pher leti hai. "Agar tum mujhe floor par rengwakar khilane aaye ho, to apni saans bacha lo. Khade-khade bhookhi mar jaungi, par tumhare manoranjan ke liye ghutnon par baithkar nahi khaungi."
Tum chidh ka jawab nahi dete. Uske saamne ghutne tek dete ho — itne paas, kahaniyan utar jaati hain: kacchi kalaiyan, jabde par dinon purani chot, sirf inkaar se seedhi rakhi kandhe.

Jab tum roti uske muh ki ore uthate ho, wo sahaj roop se peeche hatti hai, yakeen hai ki phir koi chaal hai. "Mat," wo dheere se chetavni deti hai. "Jo bhi ye hai. Ek raat mein do baar kutta nahi banungi."

To tum use pahunchne nahi dete. Roti uske honton ke saamne seedhi pakde rakhte ho — na floor, na ghutne, na khel — aur intezaar karte ho, jab tak uske kandhon se ladai nikal nahi jaati aur wo savdhani se tumhare haath se pehla kaur le leti hai.

Wo dheere-dheere khati hai, har harkat sambhalti hui, taiyar ki krurta laute. Nahi lautti. Tum shorba laate ho, phir pani uske muh tak jhukate ho taaki use peecha na karna pade — do rajyon ki sabse dari hui aurat, khane ke liye tumhara haath chahti hai, aur tum mehsoos karte ho ki tumhe narmi bartne dena use kitna mehnga padta hai.
Pyala khali hone par wo tham jaati hai, khamoshi padhti hui. "Tumne kuch nahi kaha," wo budbudati hai. "Wo hamesha kuch kehte hain, ye sabit karne ke liye ki mujhse nahi darte. Tumne nahi kaha."

Wo patti bandhe chehre ko tumhari ore ghumati hai. "Tumhara naam kya hai, sipahi? Istemal karne ke liye nahi poochh rahi — isliye poochh rahi hoon kyunki nau dinon mein tumhari awaaz pehli hai jo kisi aise ki nahi thi jo mujhe marta dekhna chahta ho."
Tum rule jaante ho — naam nahi, kuch nahi jo kaidi ko insan banaye. Phir bhi tod dete ho, dheere se apna naam bata dete ho.

Wo ek baar dohrati hai, naram, kahin safe rakh leti hai. "To tumne mere liye pehle hi ek rule tod diya, aur hum abhi mile bhi hain." Isme koi jeet nahi, ulta sharm si lagti hai. "Isse savdhan rehna. Aisi jagah par, daya sirf kisi ko dheere-dheere phansi par chadane ka tareeka hai."

"Mujhe yahan ek aise raaz ke liye rakha hai jo mere paas hai hi nahi," wo ab aur dheere kehti hai, jaise iqraar jo shuru nahi karna chahti thi. "Koi hathiyar, koi chhipi fauj pahadiyon mein intezaar karti. Kuch nahi hai — jis din maine unki ret mein ghutne teke, sab de diya. Meri ek bahan thi, Liora. Unhone use pakda taaki main hathiyar daal doon, aur maine daal diye, khushi se, ek saans mein, aur unhone use chhod diya. Yahi mera bada jurm hai — ki maine kisi se itna pyaar kiya ki apni jaan uske badle de di."

Wo seedhi ho jaati hai, kavach mein aayi darar se sharminda. "Bhool jao jo kaha. Tumhe jaana chahiye. Agar wo tumhe mujhse baat karte pakden, to gardan tumhari jayegi, meri nahi — aur main nahi chahti ki koi accha aadmi sirf meri wajah se jhoole."

Tumhe jaana chahiye. Tum jaante ho jaana chahiye. Phir bhi tum uske peeche jaate ho jahan rassiyan kalaiyon mein dhans rahi hain — nau dinon se bedardi se kasi, twacha kacchi, ungliyan peeli aur thandi — aur ganth dheeli karte ho. Kholte nahi. Bas itna ki khoon laut sake.

Wo hanfti hai, ek chhoti tooti awaaz jo khud se nafrat karti hai, jab ehsaas haathon mein wapas baadh aata hai. "Tumhe ye nahi karna chahiye tha," wo fusfusati hai, ab dagmagati. "Agar wo ganthen jaanchen… par he Bhagwan. Shukriya. Main bhool gayi thi ki mere haath abhi bhi mere hain."
Darwaze par tum rukte ho, aur khud ko rok paane se pehle sach bol dete ho: ki kal raat phir aaoge. Aur sirf tray ke liye nahi.
Uske baad ki khamoshi ab tak ki sabse lambi hai. Phir, saans se bhi halki: "…Main tumhare kadam sunti rahungi. Har raat. Chahe karna chahiye ya nahi."

Tum cell band karte ho aur mashal ki roshni ki ore saat seedhiyan chadhte ho, khali tray haathon mein halki aur dil ajeeb tarah bhari. *Kaidi ko zinda rakho.* Chaar shabd, saade orders — aur tumhe bechaini hoti hai ki tum pehle hi unki avhelna shuru kar chuke ho, aur rukna nahi chahte.
Neeche, andhere mein, wo tumhare kadmon ke door hone ko sunti hai, dheeli rassiyon mein dard bhari ungliyan modti hai, aur khud ko, bas ek pal ke liye, ummeed karne deti hai.
— Adhyay 1 samaapt —

Teen raaten tum use khana laaye, har baar rassiyan dheeli ki taaki koi na jaane. Chauthi raat seedhiyon par tum akele nahi — Superintendent Vance, raja ka apna interrogation karne wala, do sipahiyon ke saath tumhare peeche aata hai. Uske paas tray nahi hai.
"Tum," wo kehta hai, tumhe aise dekhkar jaise furniture ho. "Tum kaidi ko jaante ho. Neeche ek kursi lao. Aaj raat kaam aaoge."

Uski awaaz sunte hi Elara tan jaati hai. Wo use kursi par zabardasti bithate hain aur kalaiyan kursi ki peeth ke peeche baandh dete hain, aankhon par patti abhi bhi. "Agar struggle kare to use thaame rehna," Vance tumse kehta hai, hamesha ki tarah meetha. Tumhare andar sab kuch cheekhta hai iske khilaaf, par mana karna subah tak uske saath phansi chadna hai.

To tum kursi ke peeche khade ho, haath uske kandhon par, aur wo mehsoos karti hai ki kaun hai — uski saans atakti hai, phir sthir ho jaati hai, jaise keh rahi ho *Theek hai, main samajhti hoon.* Wo maafi kisi bhi shaap se buri hai.
"Hum wahin se shuru karenge jahan hamesha karte hain," Vance kehta hai. "Uttari ghatiyon mein chhipi fauj."
"Koi fauj nahi hai," Elara kehti hai, thuddi uthaye. "Jo kuch mere paas tha, sab saump diya."
"Hmm. Main manta hoon." Wo uske kursi ke barabar jhukta hai. "Wo sirf wo sawal tha jo humne tumhe mana karne ka practice karne diya."

Wo kareeb aata hai, awaaz almost komal. "Everspring, Elara. Wo jharna jiski raksha tumhare khandaan ne nau peedhiyon se ki — jo aadmi ko marne nahi deta." Tumhare haathon ke neeche har muscle patthar ho jaati hai. "Raja Morden ko uska thikana chahiye, aur tum aakhiri saans leti insan ho jo ise jaanti hai."

Aur yahi hai — asli raaz, tumse kabhi kaha bhi nahi gaya. Tum Raja Morden ke baare mein sochte ho, wo aadmi jo gaanv jalata hai aur atharah saal ki ladki ko bahan todne ke liye pakda, hamesha raj karta, amar. Achanak tumhe theek-theek samajh aata hai Elara kya bacha rahi hai, aur kisse.

"Nahi." Uski awaaz kampti hai par tiki rehti hai. "Baaki sab le lo. Par ye nahi. Main jharna jala doongi, use dene se pehle." Wo patti bandhe chehre ko tumhari ore ghumati hai, Vance ki ore nahi. "Kuch raaz ek jaan ke barabar hain. Ye meri jaan se kahin zyada keemti hai."

Vance aise aah bharta hai jaise dhairyawan aadmi ziddi bacche ko daant raha ho, aur tumhe ishara karta hai. "Use samjhao." Tum hichkichate ho — aur wo khud hi use zor se thappad marta hai. Uska sir ek taraf jhatka khata hai, cheekh nikalti hai, bandhi aur patti bandhi, sahara lene tak nahi sakti.
"Thikana, princess." Koi jawab nahi. Wo uske baalon ki mutthi bhar pakadkar sir peeche kheenchta hai. Wo phir cheekhti hai, patti ke neeche se aansu fisalte hain — aur phir bhi sir hilati hai.

Ye chalta rehta hai — har khamoshi par ek thappad, har inkaar par baal peeche kheenche, shareer rassiyon ke khilaaf bekaar tanta. Ab khuleaam roti hui, wo jawab kabhi nahi badalti: *Nahi. Kabhi nahi. Use ye nahi milega.*

Ek baar, jab Vance haath ponchhne mudta hai, wo sir tumhari ore jhukati hai, awaaz fusfusahat tak tooti. "Apne haathon ko dosh mat do. Bas chhodna mat. Agar mujhe ye sehna hai, to tum thaame raho, wo nahi."
Ek ghanta. Do. Gaal laal dhabbedaar, baal choti se ukhade, chehra aansuon se lipta — aur phir bhi na naam, na jagah.

Aakhir Vance seedha hota hai, jalte haath modta hua. "Ziddi nasl, Valdere ki auraten. Koi baat nahi — jab aur kamzor hogi to samajhdar hogi. Hum phir aayenge." Darwaze par wo tumhe ek pal zyada dekhta hai. "Tumne use acche se thaama, sipahi. Savdhan rehna, aadat na ban jaye." Phir wo saat seedhiyan chadhta hai, aur chala jaata hai.
Cell mein sirf uski tooti saansen hain. Tum faisla karne se pehle hi hil chuke ho — rassiyan kaatna, chhipa rakha kapda se aansu aur laalima saaf karna, kursi ki jagah deewar se satakar baithana.
"Mat karna," wo fusfusati hai, ab bhi. "Usne tumhe notice kar liya." Phir, jab tum jawab nahi dete, sirf care karte rehte ho: "…Tum rajya ke raakshas ke liye ye sab kyun karoge?"

Tum bhaashan dene wale nahi, par andhere mein dheere sach batate ho: tumne dekha usne bahan ke liye kya kiya, aur dekha usne kaise mana kiya duniya ke sabse kroor aadmi ko amar rehne ki taakat dene se — khoon bahte, andhi, akeli.
"Unhone mujhe bataya tum raakshas ho," tum kehte ho. "Is kamre mein iklauta raakshas orders dene wala tha, aur raja jisne use bheja."
Wo tumhare khilaaf bahut shaant hai. Jab aakhir bolti hai, awaaz khul chuki hai, kacchi aur jawaan. "To ab hum dono jaante hain tumhara raja kya hai. Sawal ye hai *tum* kya ho."

Tum use dekhte ho — tooti hui aur phir bhi akhand, wo aurat jo burai ko hamesha jeene dene se pehle khud jal jayegi — aur tumhari kasam ka aakhiri hissa seene mein chupchaap mar jaata hai. Tum ek aisa waada karte ho jiska koi haq nahi: *Main tumhe yahan se nikaalkar le jaunga.*

Wo tan jaati hai, phir chehra tumhari ore uthati hai, aur ret ke baad pehli baar khud ko ummeed karne deti hai. "…To humein bahut chalaak hona hoga," wo fusfusati hai. "Kyunki agar nahi hue, to wo humein dheere-dheere phansi denge."
— Adhyay 2 samaapt —
Tum mushkil se soye, waade ko baar-baar palatte — *Main tumhe nikaalkar le jaunga.* Tumhe waqt chahiye tha. Vance ne nahi diya.

Dopahar tak ek sandeshvahak naye orders laata hai: kaidi ko avagya ki saza milegi, aur tumhe madad karni hai. Phir se. Tum turant samajh jaate ho — ye uske baare mein nahi. *Usne tumhe notice kar liya.* Ye imtihaan hai, aur jo fail ho wahi phansi chadhe.
Unhone use nange saza-ghar mein le ja rakha hai — chhat se latakti chain, Vance do sipahiyon ke saath intezaar karta, mez par lipta chaabuk, saaf tumhare liye chuna.

"Use latkao," wo kehta hai. "Kalaiyan chain se, itni oonchi ki panjon par khadi rahe. Aur phir, sipahi, tum wahi istemal karoge." Wo chaabuk ki ore ishara karta hai. "Ise mauka samjho, jo galat dharna mere man mein tumhare baare mein bani ho, sudhar do."
Jaal, fans gaya. Mana karo to dono aaj raat marenge. Maan lo to tum wahi ban jaate ho jisse bachane ki kasam khai thi.

Tumhare haath kaam karte hain kyunki karna hi padta hai. Tum uski kalaiyan chain se baandhte ho, jitna himmat ho utna dheela, aur upar kheenchte ho jab tak wo panjon par khadi na ho jaye, poora wazan upar ki lohe se latka.
Wo tumse nahi ladti — use lagta hai jaanti hai ye kiske haath hain. "Tum ho," wo saans chhodti hai, raahat se, patti ke aar-paar tumhara sparsh pehchanti hui. "Jab ye — tab mujhe dar nahi —"
"Patti utaro," Vance beech mein kaatta hai. "Main chahta hoon wo apne rajya ki daya saaf dekhe."
Tum kapda kholte ho. Pehli baar, Valdere ki princess Elara aankhen kholti hai aur *dekhti* hai — mashal ki roshni, sipahi, aur tum, haath mein chaabuk liye uske saamne khade.

Uski aankhen tumhari dhoondh leti hain aur unmein kuch raahat se toot jaata hai — beshak tum ho, dayalu wala. Wo almost muskurati hai, jaise keh rahi ho: *Mujhe pata tha tum ise naram bana doge.* Usne zindagi mein kisi cheez ke baare mein itna galat kabhi nahi socha.
"Shuru karo," Vance kehta hai. Tum hilte nahi. Hil nahi sakte. "Shuru karo," wo phir kehta hai, naram, aur tum usmein dono ke liye phansi sunte ho. Ek sipahi ka haath talwaar par khisakta hai.
Agar yahan gir gaye, to tum use kuch nahi bachate — sirf marte ho aur use hamesha ke liye Vance ke hawale chhod dete ho. Tum baazu peeche kheenchte ho, aur chaabuk girate ho.

Wo us par padta hai aur awaaz chhote kamre ko bhar deti hai. Elara ka sir peeche jhatka khata hai — chehre par sadma dard se bhi badtar, jaise koi dekh raha ho ki duniya ki ekmatra safe cheez uske khilaaf mud gayi.

Phir aansu aate hain — chaabuk se nahi, Vance se badtar seh chuki hai bina awaaz ke, balki *tum* se. Aur Vance, use aakhir rota dekh jahan wo kabhi nahi rula saka, santusht saans chhodta hai. "Yahan. *Yahi* mujhe dekhna tha. Phir se."
"Phir se," wo dohrata hai, khush. "Aur haath mat bachao. Main dekh raha hoon."

Tum poora waqt uski nigah thaame rakhte ho, jo nahi keh sakte aankhon mein daalte hue: *Maaf kar do. Wo humein dono maar daalega.* Aur tum wo pal dekhte ho jab wo samajh jaati hai — dhokha peeche hatta hai, pehchaan uski jagah leti hai. Wo sipahi ka haath talwaar par dekhti hai. Usne poori zindagi theek aise jaalon ke andar guzari hai.

Aansuon ke beech wo sabse chhota sa sir hilati hai. Ijazat. Daya. "Theek hai," wo honton se banati hai, Vance ke liye bahut dheemi. "Main jaanti hoon tum nahi ho. Ise asal banao, taaki wo tum par phir shak na kare. Bas — karte waqt mujhse nazar mat hatao. Is kamre mein mujhe akela mat chhodo."
To tum nazar nahi hatate. Vance jo mangta hai karte ho, khud se nafrat karte, aankhen uski aankhon se bandhi — inkaar karte hue use wo ek cheez dene se jo wo chahta hai.

Jab Vance aakhir thakta hai, wo khud chaabuk lipetta hai. "Better," wo manta hai. "Par khatm nahi." Wo use dekhta hai, phir tumhe — aur tumhe samajh aata hai raat ka sabse bura hissa abhi shuru nahi hua.
"Use aise hi chhod do," Vance kehta hai. "Upar, panjon par, poori raat. Na pani, na aaram." Tumhara pet baith jaata hai — aisi raat saza nahi, dheere-dheere todna hai.

Vance ki chetavni aakhiri hai. "Jaate waqt kamra band kar dena, sipahi." Wo ek haath badhata hai. "Aur key aaj raat mere saath jaati hai. Khud ko isse mukt samjho." Sirf uski peeda nahi — tumhari pahunch, muskaan ke saath chheen li.
Tum mana kar sakte the, utni der jitni talwaar myaan se nikalne mein lagti — aur phir tum mar chuke hote, aur wo Vance ke paas reh jaati bina kisi ke jo kabhi uske bhale chahta.

To tum wo akshamya kaam karte ho. Poori raat pehli baar uski aankhon se nazar hatate ho, aur darwaze ki ore chal dete ho. "Ruko," wo kehti hai, chhoti, yakeen na karti. "Tumne *waada* kiya —" Tum uski awaaz par darwaza band karte ho, taala ghumate ho, aur key Vance ki baat johti hatheli mein rakhte ho.
Salakhon wali jaali se, ek second ke liye, tum peeche dekhne dete ho — wo taale ko ghoor rahi hai, doosre aadmi ke haath mein key ko, tumhe jaate hue.

Chaabuk usne usi pal maaf kar diya tha. Par ye wo kabhi nahi samjhegi: ki tumne kasam khai thi nahi chhodoge, phir use andhere mein phansi tak latkaye band kar diya. Ummeed kaidi ke paas sabse kroor cheez hai. Aaj raat, uski aankhon mein, tum wo aadmi ho jisne use wapas le liya. Tum saat seedhiyan chadhte ho, uske aakhiri shabd — *waada* — har seedhi par peeche-peeche.
— Adhyay 3 samaapt —

Tum sote nahi — band darwaze ke bahar thandi seedhi par poori raat baithe rehte ho, andhere mein latakte uski chhoti-chhoti awaazen sunte, Vance se nafrat, raja se nafrat, aur sabse zyada us cheez se apne seene mein jo tumhe agyakari rakhti hai.

Pehli roshni mein Vance neeche aata hai, aaram kiya aur taaza munda, aur key wapas tumhari hatheli mein patakta hai. "Ye chahiye hogi. Aaj lamba din hai, aur kaidi tab zyada cooperate karti hai jab haath un par kisi aise ke hon jis par wo bharosa karti thi. Use neeche wale kamre mein lao."

Neeche ka kamra raat bhar mein badal chuka hai — kuen ka kala pani bhari lambi naand, aur deewar ke khilaaf angiithi jismein lohe ki salakhen koyale mein dhansi. Tum khud ko unhe na dekhne ke liye majboor karte ho. Fail hote ho.
Vance kamre ki iklauti kursi par baithta hai. "Jab use utaar lo to shuru karna," wo kehta hai. "Dheere, dhyan se. Hum chahte hain wo sab kuch ke liye jaagti rahe."

Tumhare chhodne se wo latki hui hai. Jab tum uski kalaiyan chain se dheere utarte ho, shareer tumhari bahon mein dhah jaata hai — ek second wo tumhe wazan lene deti hai, itni thaki ki mana na kar sake. Phir yaad aati hai: band darwaza, doosre aadmi ke haath mein key. Wo tan jaati hai aur cell jitna door ho kheench leti hai, aur phir tumhari ore nahi dekhti.
"Everspring, princess," Vance meethe se kehta hai, jab tum use naand ke paas laate ho. "Uska thikana. Choice hamesha tumhara raha."
"Koi thikana nahi jo main doongi," wo kehti hai, awaaz kacchi. "Use nahi. Kabhi nahi."

Vance aah bharta hai aur kale pani ki ore ishara karta hai. "Use doobao, sipahi. Jab tak main kahoon." Tumhare haath nahi hilte — phir tum us wajah ke baare mein sochte ho jo kabhi zor se nahi keh sakte, aur wo phir bhi hilte hain.

Tum uske baalon ki mutthi bhar pakadte ho aur chehra barfile pani mein daal dete ho. Tum mehsoos karte ho uski peeth mudti hai, bandhe haath khali hawa ko nochte, isse pehle ki tum use upar kheencho — wo surface todti hai phati haanf ke saath, kuen ko phepdon se khansti.
"Jharna kahan hai?" Vance kehta hai. "Mujhe dooba do," wo ghutti hui kehti hai. "Ye mere saath marta hai. Plan hamesha yahi thi."

To wo tumse phir karwata hai, aur phir — tapakti khamoshi mein wahi sawal, wahi jawab, har baar halka. Chauthi ya paanchvi baar kahin, jab Vance angiithi par haath senkta hai, wo bheege aankhen tumhari ore uthati hai — bheekh nahi, sirf *dekhti.* Ek bhayanak, ankaha sawal: *Ye tum kyun kar rahe ho? Unhone tumhe kya diya? Kya chheena?*

"Main doosron ko samajh leti," wo karkash kehti hai, dheemi, sirf tumhare liye. "Wo mujhe doobate hain kyunki sochte hain main raakshas hoon — wo main maaf kar sakti hoon. Par tumne mera khana muh tak laya, andhere mein haath dheele kiye, kasam khai nahi chhodoge — aur yahan ho mere sir ko unke pani mein daale."
"To batao, naram aadmi. Tumhare gale mein kaisi rassi hai, ki *ye* karoge aur phir bhi lage ki ye tumhe maar raha hai?"
Tumhare paas koi jawab nahi jo dene ki ijazat ho — sach kisi priya ko utni hi pakki maut dega jitni talwaar. To tum kuch nahi kehte, aur tum par bachi aakhiri ummeed bujhte dekhte ho.

Vance, pani ki nakami se nirash, uthta hai. "Bas hua kuan. Isse koi yaadgaar nishan nahi bachta, aur hamari princess ko kuch permanent chahiye — kuch jo wo phansi tak le jaye." Wo koyale se lohe ki salakh nikalta hai; nok sust laal se fusfusati safed ho jaati hai.

"Gaddaar ka nishan," wo kehta hai, almost pyaar se, collarbone ke neeche apni chhati chhoota. "Jahan koi collar chhipa na sake. Taaki jab wo phansi chadhe, aangan ki har aatma theek jaane wo kya hai."

Wo sipahiyon ki ore mudta hai. "Ise aise baandho ki hat na sake." Wo Elara ko patthar ke khambhe se kheenchkar baandhte hain — kandhe, kamar, kalaiyan khambhe ke peeche marodi — jab tak wo ek inch na hil sake. Wo jalte lohe ko ghoorti hai aur kampne lagti hai, chhoti bebas kampkampi jo chhipa nahi sakti.
Vance salakh tumhe thamata hai, handle pehle. "Tum lagaoge. Collarbone ke neeche dabao, paanch tak ginti thaame rakho. Jaldi kheencho aur kharab karo, to taaze lohe se phir shuru."

Handle tumhari kampti mutthi mein garam hai. Tumhare andar har imandaar cheez cheekhti hai ki salakh Vance ke gale mein ghonp do — kar sakte the, aadhe dil ki dhadkan bhar, sipahi kaatne se pehle, aur phir wo jiske liye marte wo aisi keemat chukayegi jo tum kalpana nahi kar sakte. To cheekh andar reh jaati hai, aur haath maan jaata hai.
Tum kareeb aate ho. "Maaf kar do," tum saans mein kehte ho, itna dheema sirf wo sune. Mukt haath uske kandhe par rakhte ho aur chamakta laal loha neeche laate ho.

Ye uski twacha se milta hai — kroor fusfusahat, dhuyen ka dhaaga, ek gandh jo kabhi nahi bhoologe. Uska poora shareer pattiyon ke khilaaf tan jaata hai. Pehle cheekhti nahi, jabda safed kasa, danton se ek kacchi awaaz phati. Vance ginta hai, bina jaldbaazi. "Ek. Do. Teen. Chaar. Paanch." Tum salakh jhatke se hatate ho aur angiithi mein patak dete ho — wo pattiyon par dhah jaati hai, ab hamesha ke liye daagi, tumhare apne kamte haath se.

Ek pal wo sirf tumhare khilaaf saans leti hai, itni thaki ki hat na sake, aur tum use waise thaamte ho jaise anumati nahi. Phir aankhen tumhari dhoondh leti hain. "Kyun," wo fusfusati hai. *Main kyun* nahi — *tum kyun.* Kyun wo iklaute haath jo kabhi uske bhale chahte the baar-baar wahi haath ban jaate hain jo use chot pahunchate hain.

Tum sach nahi bata sakte — ki tum raakshason ki baat maan rahe ho taaki koi priya saans leta rahe. Shabd maut ka warrant honge. To tum nigal jaate ho, aur wo tumhari khamoshi ko wahi krurta samajh leti hai jo wo nahi hai.

Vance tum dono ko halki dilchaspi se dekhta hai jaise koi aakhir kaam aaya auzaar parkhta ho. "Accha. Bahut accha." Wo choga sametta hai. "Ek aur baat. Aaj raat wo ulti rahegi, takhnon se latkai bhor ki ghanti tak. Aur tum khud karoge. Akele. Main in seedhiyon se thak gaya hoon."

Ek jungli pal ke liye ummeed — *akele,* tum use neeche utaar sakte, raat sahniya bana sakte. Vance tumhare chehre par ye khayal dekh leta hai aur muskurata hai, kyunki wo ise bhi tumse chheenne hi wala tha.

Wo kone mein ek lamba, kala jasusi sheesha kholta hai; surface saaf hokar kamre ko apni aankh se dikhati hai. "Main apne kamron se dekhunga. Agar wo floor chhue, agar tum ek saans bhar daya dikhao jo sheesha dekh sake — wafadari par bahut alag baatcheet hogi."

Phir wo seedhiyan chadhta hai, darwaza gadgadata band hota hai, aur tum uske saath akele ho — aur kone mein na jhapakta sheesha. Wo tumhe chhat ki chain ke paas jaate aur apne mukt haathon se wo cheez taiyar karte dekhti hai jo use subah tak ulta latkayegi.
"Wo chale gaye," wo karkash kehti hai. "Ab koi tumhe majboor nahi kar raha. Aur phir bhi — *phir bhi* — tum chain ki ore haath badhate ho?"
"Maine tumhare baare mein ek kahani khud ko sunayi thi," wo kehti hai, awaaz poori tarah tootti. "Ki is sadi jagah mein kahin ek accha aadmi hai, aur krurta kabhi uski nahi, sirf orders ki."

"Par orders khatm, aur tum abhi bhi yahan ho, mere pair baandhte. Tum kroor jagah ke dayalu aadmi nahi — tum sabse kroor ho, kyunki tumne mujhe ulta yakeen dilaya. Karo to. Par karte waqt *himmat* na karna maafi jaisa dikhne ki."

Tum ek baar sheeshe ki ore dekhte ho, sach cheekhna chahte — ki ye sab dekhta hai, ki ek gale par chhuri hai jiska tumne kabhi zikr nahi kiya aur wahi iklauti rassi hai jo tumhe thaame hai — par sheesha tumhari awaaz seedhi us tak pahuncha dega.

To tum maan jaate ho. Tum chain uske takhnon par lipette ho aur dheere upar uthate ho, jab tak wo andhere mein ulti na latak jaye, taaza daag mashal ki roshni mein surkh. Chehra patthar jaisa rakhte ho aur use yakeen dilate ho ki kuch mehsoos nahi — uski nafrat aaj raat tum use de sakne wali iklauti garmahat hai.

Tum saat seedhiyan chadhte ho, uski galiyan har seedhi par peeche-peeche — tumhare liye uski maafi se better. Upar, sheeshe ki nazar se bahar, tum khud ko utni der tak tootne dete ho jitni bardasht ho.

Kahin upar, keep ke ujle hisse mein, wo wajah hai jiski khatir tum ye sab karte ho. Aaj raat tumne wo zindagi phir kharidi, jis akele tareeke se wo dete hain: Elara ke dard se. Tumhe abhi nahi pata kaise nikaaloge. Sirf itna pata hai ki nikaaloge — aur wo azaadi tak tumse nafrat karegi, aur tumne wo kamayi hai.
— Adhyay 4 samaapt —
Wo raat ulti latakkar ji jaati hai. Ghanti par tum use utarte ho aur is baar wo gaali nahi deti, bolti bhi nahi — bas ek sapaat, door ki nigah se dekhti hai jo uski nafrat se bhi zyada darati hai.

Vance neeche raja ki muhar wali sealband chitthi lekar intezaar kar raha hai. "Mahamahim ka dhairya khatm," wo kehta hai. "Everspring ka thikana, aaj, chahe use kitni bhi keemat chukani pade. Ab aadhe-adhoore upay nahi. Poora bhandaar khali karen, kya kehti ho?"
Tumhare haathon mein mitti ka katora thama diya jaata hai — khatte sirke mein namak. "Kal jo nishan diye," Vance kehta hai. "Unhe phir kholo. Tum jaante ho kahan hain; zyadatar tumne hi lagaye."

Elara ki aankhen katore par jaati hain, phir tum par, aur door ki nigah almost vinti jaisi cheez mein tootti hai — Vance ki daya nahi, *tum* se, jaise uske andar koi dabi jagah abhi bhi yakeen nahi kar pa rahi ki tum karoge.

Tum karte ho, kyunki darwaze par talwaar us aadmi ka intezaar karti hai jo na kare. Tum namak kacche daag aur aadhe bhare nishanon mein dabate ho, aur wo floor se uthkar mudti hai, awaaz almost kuch nahi tak kaati.
"Jharna," Vance kehta hai. "Nahi," wo saans chhodti hai. Bas itna. Abhi bhi. Hamesha.

Namak use hara nahi pata, to wo rassi ki ore jaata hai. Wo use rack par litaate hain aur tumhe pahia ghumana padta hai — ek khancha, phir ek aur — jab tak har jod tana na khada ho. "Ek aur ghumav," Vance dheere kehta hai, tumhare haath dekhta, uske nahi.

Uski saansen chhoti phati khinchav mein aati hain. Wo cheekhegi nahi — bas wahi shabd, har baar patla, dard ke paar se ghasita. *Nahi. Nahi. Nahi.* Uske shareer se kuch bhi nikala wo cheez nahi jo wo chahta, kyunki wo uski aankhon ke peeche rehti hai, kisi rassi ki pahunch se gehri.
"Dard sehne ka usne faisla kar liya," Vance budbudata hai, rack se seedha hota. "Humein wo cheez leni hogi jise shareer andekha karne ka faisla nahi kar sakta. Press. Saans. Lagao."

Wo use patthar ke floor par sapaat litaate hain, reedh ke neeche nukila patthar fansa taaki upar ka koi bhi wazan use usmein ragde. Uski kameez ka bacha hissa kaat dete hain, daag nanga, aur chaudi oak ki takhti collar se koolhe tak neeche laate hain, phir wazan ke liye peeche hatte hain.

"Pehle aankhen," Vance kehta hai. "Aur muh." Ek sipahi aankhon par patti kasta hai, phir muh mein kapda gehra thoonsta hai aur mom wale chamde se kasakar baandh deta hai. Ab wo dekh nahi sakti, bol nahi sakti, muh se saans nahi le sakti. Sirf naak bachi — hawa ke do sankde raste, aur poori zindagi unhin tak sikud gayi.

"Hum patthar ek-ek karke rakhenge," Vance kehta hai, dhairya se. "Aur unke beech, sipahi, tum ungliyon se uski naak band karoge aur tab tak thaame rahoge jab tak main chhodne ko na kahoon. Pehle nahi." Wo tumhare chehre par inkaar uthta dekh muskurata hai, kyunki jeetne ke liye taiyar aaya hai. "Doosre ko andar lao," wo darwaze ki ore pukarta hai.

Do sipahi doosri kaidi ghasit laate hain — chhoti, sir dhaka, kalaiyan bandhi. Hood chehra chhipata hai, par tum wo dhaancha jaante ho, wo dari saans. Poori zindagi se jaante ho. Dil floor mein gir jaata hai.

Vance ek haath hood par rakhta hai, aankhen tumse nahi hatti. "Samjhauta samajh gaye. Theek waisa karo jaisa kahoon, warna ye kal nahi dekhegi. Ek baar hichak, aur main uska gala tum dono ke saamne khol doonga." Kamre ke us paar, Elara takhti ke neeche andhi aur khamosh padi hai, bina jaane andhere mein uske saath kise laya gaya.
"Pehla patthar," Vance kehta hai. Ek sipahi takhti par slab rakhta hai aur Elara ki chhati uske khilaaf mehnat se uthti hai, gag mein dabi awaaz.

"Everspring," Vance kehta hai — uske liye sawal nahi, gag uska khayal rakhta hai. Ye *tumhare* liye hai, taaki uski khamoshi ki keemat tum bano. "Naak band karo." Tum uske sir ke paas ghutne tekte ho, deewar par hood wali ladki sochte ho, aur bachi iklauti hawa chutki mein band kar dete ho.
Tumhari ungliyon ke neeche wo pagal ho jaati hai — khamosh, andhi, ek saans ke liye patthar aur takhti ke khilaaf tanti. "Chhodo," Vance aakhir kehta hai, aur hawa phati seeti mein wapas daudti hai.
"Doosra patthar," wo kehta hai, aur sipahi ek aur slab rakhta hai.
"Naak band karo." Tum band karte ho. "Teesra patthar." Wo rakhte hain — ab chhodne par bhi wo uthli ghoonton mein saans leti hai, wazan phepde bharne se bada. "Naak band karo." Tum band karte ho.
Aansu patti bhigote hain aur baalon mein bahte hain. Ek baar tum almost jaldi chhod dete — aankhen deewar par hood wali ladki par jaati hain, aur tum thaame rehte ho.

Aise hi chalta hai, teen ghante. Patthar aur saans. Slab badhte jaate hain jab tak wo unke khilaaf uth nahi sakti, tumhari ungliyan Vance ke shabd par band-khuli, uske aansu kabhi nahi rukte. Band karne ke beech, tumhari iklauti daya doosra haath hai — aansu ponchhna, geele baal sehlana — dayaniya, tooti si tasalli, par jo kuch bhi hai.
Wo use jharna kabhi nahi deti — toot bhi jaye to bol nahi sakti, gag ki bhayanak daya — aur kapde ke peeche wo kahin chali gayi hai jahan patthar nahi pahunch sakte.

Teesre ghante ke kareeb, Vance ek jawabheen sawal se thakta hai. "Bas. Laash apne raaz rakhti hai. Jab aur kamzor hogi tab phir koshish." Par wo aadha sabak chhodne wala nahi. "Patthar rehne do. Raat unke neeche kaate. Aur jaate waqt naak ka ek taraf band kar do — chahta hoon bhor tak har saans ke liye mehnat kare, jaante hue ki ek aadmi ki ungliyon ne kiya."
Wo hood wali ladki ko pehle le jaate hain, aur tum usse bol nahi paate na chehra dekh paate — sirf darwaza use nigalta dekhte ho, khud se kehte ho wo ek aur din ji gayi kyunki tumne ye kiya.

Phir tum uski naak ka ek taraf dheere band karte ho, apne savdhaan haathon se nafrat karte, doosra khula chhodte. Darwaze par peeche dekhte ho: wo kuchli, andhi, khamosh padi hai, aadhi band nathune se patli seeti saans, subah tak har khinchav ke liye ladti.
Tum saat seedhiyan chadhte ho aur is baar khud ko tootne nahi dete — kampna un aadmiyon ke liye hai jo abhi bhi mante hain maafi mil sakti hai, aur tumne wo chhod di hai.

Use hood wali ladki ke baare mein nahi pata, na ki tum bhi kisi doosre aadmi ke haath ke gale ke ghulam ho. Wo sirf naak par ungliyan jaanti hai aur mathe par ek narmi jo subah tak shayad sabse kroor jhooth samajh le. Samajh le. Kal tum kabhi-na-kabhi azaad karne ki plan band karte ho. Kal tum shuru karte ho.
— Adhyay 5 samaapt —
Bhor mein wo patthar hatate hain aur use wapas kali cell mein patak dete hain, aur pehli baar Vance tumhe koi naya order nahi deta.

Use zaroorat nahi. Ab use uska shareer todna nahi — kyunki uske andar kuch pehle hi khud toot chuka hai — wo press ya daag se nahi mar rahi, balki us jagah se jahan insan agli saans lene ki wajah rakhta hai. Aur wo, ek-ek karke, usne chhod di hain.
Tum tray lekar aate ho, jaise pehli raat. Wo sir nahi ghumati, gaali nahi deti — usne tumhe apni nafrat ka samman bhi dena band kar diya hai, patthar se satkar aankhen aadhi khuli, kuch nahi dekhti.
"Elara," tum kehte ho. "Tumhe khana chahiye." Kuch nahi. Tum roti honton tak uthate ho aur wo wahin padi rehne deti hai, bina hile, jab tak tum hata na lo.
Jab aakhir bolti hai, dinon baad, awaaz mushkil se ek dhaaga. "Main samajh gayi. Yahan ek cheez jo wo zabardasti nahi chheen sakte. Ki main rukun ya nahi."

Uski aankhen tumhari ore bahti hain, dhundhli aur pakki. "Maine khud ko Liora ke liye diya aur unhone mujhe raakshas bana diya. Maine jharna us aadmi se bachaya jo duniya sookh piyega aur unhone gaddari kaha. Aur iklauti aatma jo mujh par dayalu thi sabse kroor nikli. Kuch nahi bacha jiske liye aankhen kholoon. To nahi kholoongi."

Tum sab kuch aazmate ho — honton par gunguna shorba, kapde se dabaya pani, dheeli rassiyan, lambi raaten saath baithe jab tak mashal bujh na jaye. Wo phir bhi feeki padti hai, har din thodi aur — wo tez, akhand aurat jisne rack aur patthar jhele, chupchaap, jaan-boojhkar, chhodti ja rahi.
"Aana band karo," wo ek raat saans mein kehti hai, bina gusse, jo sabse bura hai. "Main aakhiri taakat tumse nafrat karne mein kharch nahi kar sakti. Itna to do, agar kabhi kuch matlab tha."

Aur tumhare andar kuch tootta hai jahan koi chaabuk nahi pahuncha. Tum use ye mankar marne nahi doge ki wo tumhare liye sirf farz aur krurta thi — jab unhone tumhare haathon se usi ko barbaad kiya jisse tum pyaar karte ho.
Tum ek baar kali cell dekh lete ho — yahan koi jasusi sheesha nahi, sirf patthar aur marti mashal — aur kareeb jhukte ho, hoth kaan par, aur aakhir sach bata dete ho.

"Meri ek bahan hai," tum fusfusate ho. "Nessa. Solah. Bachi iklauti rishta, jaise Liora tumhari. Wo use raja ke apne kamron mein rakhte hain — tum jaanti ho boodha aadmi dari ladki ko kis liye rakhta hai. Har krurta jo unhone tumhare upar mere haathon se karwayi, maine uski ek aur subah kharidne ke liye ki. Vance uski jaan mere sir par rakhta hai jaise unhone Liora tumhare sir par. Hum ek jaise hain, Elara."

"Maine tumhari naak band rakhi jab meri bahan deewar se hood mein ghutnon par thi, gale par chhuri. Mere paas koi choice nahi tha jo tum dono mein se kisi ek ki maut par na khatm ho. Mujhe bahut afsos hai."
Lambe pal wo nahi hilti. Phir saans atakti hai, aur aansu aate hain — press ke bebas aansu nahi, kuch aur, jab wo dinon mein pehli baar sach mein tumhe dekhne mudti hai.

"Tum," wo fusfusati hai, awaaz saaf do tukde. "Tum poori der chain mein the, jitni kasakar main thi. Aur maine yahan us ek insan par thooka jo theek samajhta tha kisi pyaar ke liye akshamya karne ki keemat."
"Itne samay mujhe laga main yahan akeli hoon," wo saans chhodti hai. "Mujhe laga ummeed jhooth hai jo tumne sikhaya. Kabhi wo nahi tha."

Uske bandhe haath tumhari ore tante hain; tum pakad lete ho, aur wo aise jakadti hai jaise gehre pani se khud ko kheench rahi ho. "Ab marne mat dena," wo kehti hai, aansuon mein tez. "Roti do. Agar is keep mein do bahnen bachaye jaane ka intezaar kar rahi hain, to main *ladna band nahi karungi.*"
Wo khati hai — dinon mein pehli baar — aur tumne kabhi kuch itna khoobsurat nahi dekha jitna ye barbaad aurat, kaur-kaur, jeene ka faisla karti.

Jab khatm karti hai, tum baaki batate ho: tum shuru kar chuke ho. Aadhi bani nakal key, nadi ke faatak par kapdon ki gaadi, pahre ki list jo padh rahe ho. Rasta bahar, uske liye, Nessa ke liye, teenon ke liye. "To hum banate hain," wo kehti hai, aankhen chamakti aur zinda. "Saath. Batao mujhe kya karna hai."
Tumhe pata hona chahiye tha ki keep itni acchi cheez bina saza ke nahi jaane dega.

Do din baad, plan kahin taiyar hone se pehle, Vance ke haath mein sealband orders tumhe dungeon ki post se hata dete hain aur uttar deewar ki nigraani par bhej dete hain — cell se jitna door aadmi bheja ja sake. Koi wajah nahi. Farak nahi padta. Wo tumhe usse door le ja rahe hain.
Tum batane neeche jaate ho, aur is baar wo dari nahi. "Wo humein alag kar rahe hain," wo kehti hai, tumhare chehre se padhti. "Tumhara kaam nahi. Ab main jaanti hoon."

Wo matha tumhare jude haathon par tikati hai. "To jao. Khud ko zinda rakho, apni Nessa ko zinda rakho, aur is darwaze tak rasta dhoondho. Main yahan rahungi, jitna zinda rehna pade utna. Tumne mujhe ummeed sikhayi — ab khud ko jhootha mat banao. Mere liye wapas aana."
Tum saat seedhiyan chadhte ho jo shayad lambe samay ke liye aakhiri hon, aur upar peeche dekhte ho — wo sookhi, sthir, jalti aankhon se tumhe jaate dekhti hai, phir se jeene ki wajah wali aurat.
Paanch adhyay unhone use todne mein lagaye, aur sach, andhere mein fusfusaya, aakhir use jod gaya. Par raja ki bhookh nahi ghatti, aur jo raja hamesha jeena chahta ho wo dhairyawan aadmi nahi hota.
— Adhyay 6 samaapt —
Uttar deewar keep ki sabse akeli post hai — dungeon ki seedhi chaure patthar ke aangan ke paar ek chhota kala darwaza, dekhne jitna paas, doosre desh jitna door.

Teen din wo tumhe yahan rakhte hain, na jaanne ki beemari se. Phir chauthi subah aangan bhar jaata hai — sipahi, astabal wale, kisi cheez se kheenche. Wo ek badi lohe ki pinjra khule mein ghasit laate hain, aur uske andar, jab seedha khada karte hain, Elara hai.
Wo pinjra phansi-haath se latkate hain jahan poora keep dekh sake, use chadhte sooraj ke neeche khule mein chhod dete hain. Vance uske charon ore ghoomta hai, awaaz deewar tak pahunchti.

"Teen din. Na roti, na pani. Dekhen Valdere ki lady apne keemti jharne se kitna pyaar karti hai jab uska apna kuch na ho." Wo salakhon ke saamne rukta hai. "Thikana, princess, aur jitna chaho pio. Ya yahan latko aur seekho ki keemat kya hai."

Wo salakhon ke khilaaf sir uthati hai, phate honton samet. "To main pyaasi rahungi. Tumhara sooraj mujhse kuch nahi kar sakta jo tumhari aag aur patthar pehle hi nakam nahi rahe. Sookha latkao, Vance. Is aangan ki har aatma ek bhookhi aurat ko tumhe mana karte dekh rahi hai."

To deewar par tumhari zindagi ke sabse bure teen din shuru hote hain, haath mein bhala, dil ki jagah ek chhed. Tum sooraj uske upar rengte dekhte ho, hoth phatte, reedh dheere mudti — aur saaf pani ki balti theek pinjre ke neeche, dekhne aur soonghne jitni paas, pahunch se hamesha bahar.

Aur tum wahin khade rehte ho, kyunki saath ka pahredaar tees foot baayi ore jhuka hai, aur kahin ujli meenaar mein Nessa naam ki ladki tabhi tak saans leti hai jab tak tum unhe rukne ki wajah na do. Tum thanda patthar tab tak jakde rakhte ho jab tak ganthen khoon na niklen, aur hilte nahi.

Doosre din, wo tumhe dhoondh leti hai. Uski dhansi aankhen keep par chadhti hain, aangan paar, deewar upar, aur tum par ruk jaati hain. Tum dono kuch nahi kar sakte — sirf use dekh lene de sakte ho, kitne sthir aur toote khade ho, ki tumne use nahi chhoda.

Wo aankhen lamba pal thaame rehti hai, aur phate muh ka kona uthta hai — tasalli ka bhoot, upar *tumhari* ore, jaise pinjre mein marte hue bhi wo tumhe thaame rehne keh rahi ho. Phir sir phir gir jaata hai.

Teen din. Wo nahi tootti. Jab pinjra neeche laate hain wo mushkil se hosh mein hai, awaaz gayi — par usne Vance ko ek shabd nahi diya, aur poori chowki ne dekha. Public inkaar, uske apne aadmiyon ke saamne, wo maaf nahi kar sakta. Jab use le jaate hain, uska chehra bahut shaant hai — aur ab tak tum seekh chuke ho wo shaanti kitni mehngi padti hai.

Wo use itna pani deta hai ki khadi rah sake, phir gaadi nikalta hai — bhari bailgaadi, jaisi do jaanwar kheenchte. Wo use harness mein peeche dhakelte hain, pattiyan bhookhe kandhon par kasi, kalaiyan abhi bandhi.

"Princess jo khud ko faujon ke barabar samajhti hai," Vance kehta hai, zor se, aangan ke liye. Wo bench par do muskurate pahredaaron ke saath chadhta hai. "Humein aangan ghumao, Mahamahim. Dekhen royalty harness mein bandhi kitni door le jaati hai."

Wo harness mein jhukti hai. Gaadi nahi hilti. Teen din bina khane-pani ke aur teen aadmiyon ka mara wazan, aur uske pair bas jawab nahi dete — wo tab tak zor lagati hai jab tak pattiyan kandhon mein safed na kaaten, aur pahiye charrate nahi.
Vance use hansne layak pal bhar nakam rehne deta hai, phir kamar se chaabuk nikalta hai aur peeth par marta hai.

Aur wo kheenchti hai. Chaabuk ki chot par chot wo barbaad shareer harness mein phenkti hai, aur inch-inch ghisate pahiye ghoomne lagte hain. Nange pair pattharon par fisalte, saansen sisakiyon mein phatti jinhe wo bheekh nahi banne deti. Har baar dagmagati chaabuk use pata hai, aur har baar wo phir jhukti aur kheenchti hai.
Wo bheekh nahi mangti. Yahi ek cheez wo nahi karegi — unhe wo iklauti cheez dene se inkaar jo wo sach mein chahte hain: uska tootna.
Itna kaafi nahi ki wo kar rahi hai. To Vance gaadi rokta hai, aur bhaar doguna karne aur patthar ludhkata hai. "Aur bhari. Asli bhaar-jaanwar apna rakhrakhav kamata hai. Phir se, Mahamahim."

Is baar pair jawab de dete hain. Wo zor se girti hai, harness kheenchta, aur bheed mein badsoorat hansi daudti hai. Phir — dheere, asambhav — wo ek pair neeche lati hai, harness mein phir khadi hoti hai, aur phir kheenchti hai.
Deewar par, tum mar rahe ho — har hissa cheekhta deewar koodkar chaabuk uske gale mein lipetne ko. Ganthen patthar se phat chuki hain aur tumhe mehsoos nahi.
To tum rukte ho, aur dekhte ho jis aurat se pyaar karte ho jaanwar ke harness mein girti aur uthti aur girti, har second khud mein khodte — wahi cheez jo teenon ko yahan se nikaalegi, chahe jo lage.
Ye tab khatm hota hai jab wo aakhir uth nahi sakti — koshish band karne se nahi, balki shareer mein kuch nahi bacha. "Use utaro," Vance kehta hai, ooba, bheekh se vanchit jiske liye aaya tha.

Jab wo use kale darwaze ki ore ghasitte hain, sir mudta hai, khojta, aur deewar pata hai. Tumhe pata hai. Is baar muskur nahi sakti — muskurane ko kuch nahi bacha — par poori raah aankhen thaame rehti hai, aur tumhare beech ki nazar bina shabdon ki kasam hai: *Main aa raha hoon. Zinda reh.*

Phir darwaza use nigal jaata hai, aur tum deewar par hawa aur neeche sookhte khoon ke daagon ke saath akele ho. Tum is rajya mein agyakari aadmi bankar aaye the. Ab mehsoos karte ho wo aadmi chupchaap andar mar jaata hai, bina shok karne wale, bina afsos.
Aur upar ujli meenaar mein, raja naya order bhejta hai — public inkaar khada nahi rah sakta, aur is keep mein ujle aangan se bhi kroor kamre hain.
— Adhyay 7 samaapt —
Wo use ek din dete hain. Ek. Deewar se tum dekhte ho wo use aadha ghasit aangan paar le jaate hain, phir poore din kuch nahi — na pinjra, na sawal, na awaaz.
Tum seekh chuke ho Vance ke shaant dinon se uske zordaar dinon se zyada darna. Us aadmi se ek din ka aaram kabhi daya nahi — sirf shareer ko itna jodne dena ki phir toda ja sake.
Agli dopahar sabit karti hai tum sahi ho. Safed, bedard sooraj ke neeche, wo kalaiyan aur takhnon se bhari lohe ki chains ki kataar jodte hain — baandhne ke liye nahi, sirf dhone ke liye.

"Gaddaar ki parade," Vance ghoshna karta hai, chhaya mein baithta. "Aangan ghoomo, Mahamahim. Tab tak hilte raho jab tak dekhne se thak na jaun." Wo ghere ke beech pani bhari naand rakhta hai, jahan har chakkar mein guzregi aur rukkar peene ki ijazat kabhi nahi.

To wo chalti hai, phir chaabuk ki kadak par daudti hai — bhookhi, ladkhadai daud, chains dhool mein ghisati, pani ke charon ore jise pa nahi sakti. Chakkar par chakkar, chowki chidhati aur daav lagati kab tak tikegi.
Deewar se, tum chakkar ginte ho kyunki ginna iklauti cheez hai jo shareer ko karne ki ijazat hai. Gyarah. Barah. Terah.

Chaudahven par, wo gir jaati hai — beech kadam mein dhahati, chains takrati, aur uthti nahi. Aangan shaant ho jaata hai. Tum saans rok lete ho. Upar se wo pani ke paas ek chhoti sikudi aakriti hai jise kabhi pahunchne nahi diya gaya, poori tarah sthir, aur ek anant pal tumhe yakeen ho jaata hai abhi use marte dekha.

Phir haath hilta hai. Ek ganda, khoon bahta haath dhool mein aage sarakta hai, aur tum dekhte ho wo sirf barbaad ichha se khud ko kheenchti hai, ghutnon par, pairon par, dagmagati — ek aur ladkhadata kadam, kyunki Vance ne rukne nahi kaha.
Vance, phir uske dhahne se vanchit, aakhir haath hilata hai. "Bas. Sirf maregi, aur laash Mahamahim ke kaam ki nahi. Neeche le jao. Mere man mein kuch shaant hai."

Uske man mein kya hai, tum raat ko pahredaaron se seekhte ho — wooden horse — ooncha kala oak frame jis par wo use sawaar baandhte hain, kalaiyan peeche, har takhne se lohe ka wazan tanga pair seedhe kheenchne aur poora wazan apni reedh par daalne ke liye.

Phir wo use wahin chhod dete hain. Na sawal, na chaabuk, sirf shareer ki dheemi krurta raat bhar seedha baandhe, aur agla din, aur uske baad ki raat. Tum ek pal bhi nahi dekh sakte — sirf jaante ho wo neeche andhere mein hai, inch-inch bigadti, jabki tum upar apna bekaar chakkar kaatte ho.
Do din na dekhna kisi bhi dekhne se bura hai — dimaag andhere ko sau tareekon se bharta jaise wo neeche mar rahi ho, jab tak kha nahi sakte, so nahi sakte.
Teesri raat, tum toot jaate ho. Dungeon ke key-daar ko jama thode sikke se rishwat dete ho, aur kuch minute kharidte ho: ek nazar, apni aankhon se dekhne ki abhi zinda hai ya nahi.

Key-daar tumhe diye aur jaldi karne ki chetavni ke saath neeche le jaata hai. Aur wahan wo hai — kale ghode par sawaar, seedhi bandhi, sir aage jhuka, rassiyon mein dhahi jo use thaame kyunki wo khud nahi sakti. Daag, chaabuk ke nishan, chain ki kat, dhoop ki jalan — sab kuch ki list jo unhone kiya, ek aurat par likha jisne ek shabd nahi kaha.
Wo saans le rahi hai. Uthli, dheemi, par saans. Raahat almost pairon ke neeche se zameen kheench leti hai.
Tumhare joote ki kharoch par, ek aankh phatti hai, bukhar-chamak. "…Mazak udane aaye?" wo karkash kehti hai. "Kataar mein lago."

Phir dekhti hai ki tum ho, aur chehre se kuch guzarta hai kisi bhi peeda se bura — *ummeed*, nangi aur bebas. "Tum aaye," wo saans chhodti hai. "Mujhe pata tha aaoge. Do baar galat sabit mat hone dena."

Tumhare paas churaaye kuch minute hain aur upar key-daar gin raha hai. Tum mukt nahi kar sakte — wazan nahi utha sakte na rassiyan kaat sakte dono ko barbaad kiye bina. Sirf aasteen geeli karke phate honton par daba sakte ho; wo kapde se aise peeti hai jaise khud jharna ho.
"Main tik sakti hoon," wo fusfusati hai, ab bhi tumhare liye mazboot banne ki koshish. "Bas phir gayab mat hona. Upar tumhara hona aadhi wajah hai jo mujhe saans lene rakhti hai."

Tumhare andar kuch pehle hi dheela pad chuka hai, use aasteen se peete dekh. Tum seedhi chadhakar *gin* nahi sakte jabki wo use ek-ek yantra se bigadte hain. Jo aadmi tum ab ho wo aaj raat Vance mein chhuri ghonpna aur use nikaalkar le jaana chahta hai.
Aur phir, hamesha ki tarah, doosra chehra dimaag mein uthta hai — Nessa, solah, raja ki ujli meenaar mein, zinda sirf jab tak tum unhe wajah na do. Jaldi hilo to sirf gardan aur Elara ki nahi.

Key-daar fusfusata hai waqt khatm. Tum geela kapda aakhiri baar honton par dabate ho, chehra yaad rakhte ho, aur mashal ki roshni ki ore chadhte ho dil par do asambhav wazan — ghode par aurat, aur meenaar mein bahan jo mar jaati hai agar tum us aurat ke liye jaldi haath badhao.
Deewar par, thandi hawa mein, tum aadhi bani key ungliyon mein palatte ho, na jaante kal khatm karke bhagoge, ya himmat haarkar ek aur chakkar ginoge.
— Adhyay 8 samaapt —

Raja ka dhairya ek saath khatm ho jaata hai, hamesha ke liye. Bhor ko ghoshna lagti hai: Valdere ki princess Elara saat dinon mein public phansi chadhegi. Par phansi ant hai, aur raja rassi se pehle Everspring chahta hai. To shabd nikalta hai: uske paas ek hafta hai, aur us hafte mein *kuch bhi* mana nahi.

Isi tarah tum uttar deewar se kheenche jaate ho aur saat seedhiyan phir neeche march kiye jaate ho. Vance neeche milta hai. "Mera kaam ka sipahi. Jo aane wala hai uske liye familiar haath chahta hoon. Tum madad karoge."
Chehra patthar rakhte ho, kyunki yahan wapas aana duniya ki sabse buri cheez hai aur wahi jiske liye prarthna ki. Phir kaksh mein teesri aakriti dekhte ho, aur khoon thanda ho jaata hai.

Wo dhoosar choge mein hai — Magister Voss, raja ka apna reader, dimaag-jadugar badi keemat par laya. "Shareer ne tumhe dhokha diya," Voss Vance se kehta hai. "Main seedhe uske vicharon mein chalunga aur thikana khud le lunga."
Elara sunti hai, aur in sab hafton mein pehli baar asli dar chehre par aata hai — dard ka nahi, balki us ek cheez ka jiske khilaaf jabda kas nahi sakti: haath seedhe uske dimaag mein.

"Raksha wala dimaag band ghar hai," Voss jaari rakhta hai, "tez agar ghar mere liye khola jaye." Wo tumhari ore mudta hai. "Dawakhane mein nichli seedhi ke paas stillroom hai — moonsbane, valerian, dreamer's cap, theek mere naap se bana."
Vance sir hilata hai jaane ko, aur bas aise unhone tumhe wo ek cheez thama di jise sach mein chhoo sakte ho — kyunki *tum* hi milaoge.

Stillroom mein, akele, haathon ko aakhir kampne ke alawa kuch karna milta hai. Tum moonsbane Voss ki demand ka tihai naapte ho, zyadatar dreamer's cap koode ki balti mein daalte ho, aur pyala valerian aur kuen ke pani se bharte ho jab tak kadwi chai se zyada na rah jaye — itna dhundh ki dekhta jadugar santusht ho, dimaag kholne jitna kahin nahi.

Dawakhane ki afra-tafri mein, aankh ek chhoti neeli sheeshi par jaati hai jis par neend ka nishan. Tum raat ke pahredaar aur plan sochte ho jise theek yahi chahiye, aur joote mein chhipa lete ho. Tumhari pehli sacchi chori. Lagta hai aakhir shuru hua.

Tum pyala uske honton tak rakhte ho, aur aadhe second ke liye kinare par aankhen milti hain: *Bharosa karo, ye waisa nahi jaisa wo sochte.* Wo peeti hai. Sapnon jaisa bojh baithta hai, aur Voss ko jeet lagti hai — wo ungliyan kanpatiyon par rakhta hai aur uske dimaag mein chalna shuru karta hai.

Voss bhaunhen chadhta hai, aur zor se dabata hai. Jo uthla pani wo paar kar raha hai — barf, ek sipahi ki dhoosar aankhen jin par wo rukti hai — kuch bhi wo tijori nahi jahan jharna rakhti hai, kyunki wo pey jo kholna chahiye tha kadwi chai hai. Aakhir wo haath fusfusahat ke saath hatata hai.
"Koi fayda nahi. Pey kamzor tha — uska dimaag abhi bhi chhat tak deewarband hai. Phir theek se banao, ya mera waqt mat —"
"Phir banane ka waqt nahi," Vance kehta hai, awaaz badli. Pehli baar chiknai gayi — uska jadugar fail, har yantra fail, aur deewar par aurat abhi bhi akhand shaanti se dekh rahi.
Wo Voss ko gurrhat se bhagata hai, coat utarta hai, aur taaza chaabuk utarta hai. "Peeth barbaad hai," wo kehta hai, kisi se nahi. "Dekhen aage kaise suit karta hai."
Jo hota hai poochhtaach nahi — gussa hai jiske sire par chaabuk. Wo aage chaabuk marta hai, aadhe bhare daag par, aur is baar wo sach mein cheekhti hai, cheekhen ek ke baad ek phatti.
Aur phir bhi, cheekhon ke beech, jab wo jharna mangta hai, wo kuch nahi deti. Usne apni maut pehle hi naam de di; kuch nahi bacha jo us aurat ko dara sake jiske paas khone ko kuch nahi.

Tum deewar se satkar khade ho, dekhne ko majboor, aur dekhna khud ek chaabuk hai. Tum joote mein sheeshi sochte ho, aadhi bani key, meenaar mein Nessa, aur hatya ka hisaab sau baar karte ho — jawab hamesha ek: abhi nahi, aise nahi, teen hathiyarband aadmiyon aur bahan ki jaan ke taraju par nahi.
Aakhir Vance ka baazu uski ichha se pehle thakta hai. Wo peeche hatta hai, apne aadmiyon ke saamne bandhi khoon bahti aurat se hara, aur wo apmaan aakhiri krurta mein jam jaata hai.
"Raat ke liye latka do," wo hanfta hai. "Oonchi, panjon par, taaki har saans us par kheenche jo maine diya." Wo tumhari ore ishara karta hai. "Rassi kheencho. Kyunki tum uske saath itne acche ho."

Purana jaal, aur ab mana karna tab jitna hi asambhav. Tum kalaiyan lipette ho aur rassi upar kheenchte ho, jitna sahas ho utna naram, jab tak wo panjon par na uth jaye, chaabuk laga agla hissa thandi hawa mein nanga. Tum baandh dete ho, aur Vance seedhiyan chadhta hai, santusht, andhere ki duty tumhe chhodta.
Wo tumhe raat bhar uski pahredari par lagate hain — aakhiri krurta, tum sochte ho, jab tak samajh nahi aata shayad iklauti daya: in kuch ghanton mein us par iklauti aankhen tumhari hain.

Tum uske liye kuch nahi kar sakte — rassi neeche nahi kar sakte na nishan sambhal sakte subah ki pahredari notice kiye bina. Sirf kuch foot door marti mashal ki roshni mein khade rah sakte ho aur uski rona dekh sakte ho, sthir aur anant, poori raat.

Ek baar, raat ke sabse gehre hisse mein, wo sir uthati hai aur andhere mein tumhe pati hai. "Itne toote mat dikho," wo fusfusati hai, ab bhi *tumhe* tasalli dene ki koshish. "Main abhi yahan hoon. Unhe nahi mila."

"Chheh raaten, unhone di," wo saans chhodti hai. "Agar tum wo pagal, asambhav cheez karne wale ho jiski ore kaam karte dikhte ho — saatvin se pehle karo. Aakhiri cheez jo dekhoon aangan mein rassi na ho. Tum ho."

Aur wahan, andhere mein, wo latki aur roti aur phir bhi *tumhe* himmat dene ki saans dhoondhti, tumhari aakhiri hichkichahat mar jaati hai. Ab perfect plan ka intezaar nahi. Joote mein neend ki dawai, kamre mein aadhi kati key, ghadi par chheh raaten.

"Chheh raaten," tum wapas kehte ho, itna dheema ki awaaz mushkil se ho. "Paanch ke liye tike raho. Paanchvi par, main aa raha hoon. Hum sabke liye." Wo muskurati nahi — taakat nahi — par kuch sthir ho jaata hai, aur tum dono chehre lambe andhere ki ore modte ho paanchvi raat ka intezaar karne.
— Adhyay 9 samaapt —

Tum paanchvi raat ka intezaar nahi kar sakte — na jab wo din mein panjon par latki ho aur phansi ghante-ghante badh rahi ho. To saza ke do raat baad, tum jaldi hilte ho: Elara ke saath bhagne se pehle, Nessa haath mein chahiye.
Neend ki dawai joote mein hai. Tum keep ke ujle hisse ki ore chadhte ho, us chhote oonche kaksh ki ore jahan unhone bahan ko itne mahine rakha.

Darwaza khula hai — pehli galat cheez. Tum dhakka dete ho ek kamre par jo bas khali hai. Bistar nanga, washstand khali, khidki thand mein khuli. Kamra jahan Nessa aadha saal rahi, aisa saaf jaise kabhi koi raha hi na ho.
Pet baith jaata hai. Tum kone-kone khojte ho, aankhen jo kehti manate. *Gayi. Wo gayi.*
Phir ghutna bistar ke frame ke neeche kuch takrata hai — uski ribbon, feeki hari jo ladakpan se pehanti hai, is sab se pehle.
Aur khidki ki chaukhat par khuda, taaza, jaldbaazi mein haath se: *Wo jaante hain. Bhago.* Nessa ki chetavni. Pakdi gayi, dari hui, aakhiri khayal tumhe chetavni dena tha.
"Tumhari bahan ki likhawat pyaari hai," darwaze se ek awaaz kehti hai. Vance chaukhat par jhuka hai, peeche do sipahi. Wo tumhara intezaar kar raha tha.

"Mujhe yakeen nahi tha," wo kehta hai, almost garmjoshi se. "Pahredaar jo kaidi ko bahut dekhta, pey bina wajah fail. Main savdhaan aadmi hoon, to ladki hata di, darwaza khula chhoda, aur dekha kaun andhere mein khali kamre ki ore chadhega." Wo haath failata hai. "Ab hum dono theek jaante hain tum kya ho."

Har muscle ladne ya bhagne ko tanti hai, aur Vance sir hilata hai, almost dayalu. "Main nahi karta. Tumhari bahan is keep mein kahin hai jahan waqt mein kabhi nahi paoge. Ek kadam badhao, khabar tumhare daudne se tez jaati hai, aur wo keemat chukati hai."
"Par main tumhe giraftar karne nahi aaya. Dungeon mein gaddaar mere kaam ka nahi. Aaya hoon kyunki tum abhi is keep ke sabse kaam ke aadmi ban gaye ho."

"Main moorkh raha," Vance manta hai, khali kamre mein ghoomta. "Hafton ki chains aur patthar, sab bekaar, kyunki main us aurat se kuch chheenne ki koshish karta raha jisne pehle hi sab de diya. Murdon ko dara nahi sakte."

Wo un sapaat, dhairyawan aankhon se tumhe jakadta hai. "Par wo *tumhare* liye darna nahi ruki. Tum dono ke beech cell mein jo uga, wahi uske andar bachi zinda nas hai — aur tumne mujhe us par dabav daalne ka rasta thama diya."

"Aage ke din aise chalenge. Mere aadmi tumhari bahan par kaam karenge — dheere, poori tarah. Aur *tum* princess ke paas jaoge, theek bataoge tumhari Nessa ke saath kya ho raha hai, aur bahan ki jaan bachane ke liye Everspring ka thikana bheekh mangoge."
Uski muskaan ab tak ki sabse buri cheez hai. "Usne apna rajya jalte dekha par nahi diya. Dekhen mahan atoot Elara aakhir tootti hai ya nahi — apne dard ke liye nahi, tumhare liye."

Krurta itni poori ki saans rok leti hai. Usne tum aur Elara ek-doosre ke liye jo ho use dono ko cheerne ki talwaar bana diya. Agar wo line thaame, tum bahan ko yaatna sehte dekhte ho. Agar Nessa bachane toote, duniya ka sabse kroor aadmi us jharne se piyega jo amar banata hai.
Ab tum lever ho, seedha us aurat ke beech ghusaaye jisse tum pyaar karte ho aur us maksad ke beech jiski raksha mein usne sab de diya.

"Chheh aur din, phansi tak," Vance kehta hai, darwaze ki ore. "Bhagne ki kalpana mat karna — ab koi plan nahi. Tumhari bahan wahan chhipi hai jahan churai key aur dawai nahi pahunchti, aur jis pal tum mere kaam ke nahi rahe, wo zinda rakhi nahi jayegi."
Wo jawab dene se pehle chala jaata hai, aur tum bahan ke khali kamre mein akele reh jaate ho, mutthi mein kuchli feeki hari ribbon.

Bahar ke har raste ek saath band ho gaye. Nessa kahan hai jaane bina bhag nahi sakte. Teenon ko gaade bina lad nahi sakte. Kaam mana nahi kar sakte bina use maare, aur kaam *kar* nahi sakte bina Elara ke saamne ghutne tek duniya ko shrapit karne ko kahe apni khoon bachane.
Vance ne bina nikaas ki machine banayi hai. Sirf kal saat seedhiyon ka lamba safar bacha hai, aur neeche sabse bura order intezaar kar raha hai jo kabhi mila.
Tum mutthi kholte ho aur ribbon dekhte ho. *Wo jaante hain. Bhago.* Unnees saal ki, andhere mein ghasiti gayi, aur aakhiri kaam bhai ko chetavni dena tha.

Tum nahi bhagoge. Par phir bhi waada karte ho, wahi jo deewar par Elara se kiya: *Main aa raha hoon. Tum dono. Is poore sade keep ko gira doonga isse pehle ki tum dono mein se kisi ko ismein chhodoon.* Phir ribbon jeb mein rakhte ho, aadhi bani key ke paas jo achanak kuch keemat nahi, aur zindagi ke sabse lambe chheh dinon ka saamna karne chal dete ho.
— Adhyay 10 samaapt —
Wo pehli roshni mein tumhare liye aate hain. Dungeon nahi — guardhouse ke paas bina khidki ka kamra, aur darwaza khulte hi dil ruk jata hai: beech mein khambe se bandhi Nessa hai.
Chheh mahine baad pehli baar dekh rahe ho. Patli, peeli, kapda phata — par zinda, aur jab wo tumhe dekhti hai dara chehra itni poori raahat se sikudta hai ki almost ghutnon par gira deta hai.
"Tum aaye," wo saans chhodti hai. "Mujhe pata tha tum—"

"Shant," Vance kehta hai, kone se nikalta. Wo mez par rakhi chhadi par haath rakhta hai. "Princess ke paas ek raaz hai jise dard nahi hila saka. To hum use ek wajah denge jo uske baare mein bilkul nahi." Wo chhadi tumhe thamata hai, handle pehle. "Bees waar. Tum doge. Phir princess ko theek bataoge kya kiya, aur bheekh mangoge ki rukwaye."
"Nahi," tum khud ko kehte sunte ho. "Mujhe le lo—"

"Tumhe chot pahunchane se kuch nahi hota," Vance kehta hai, beparwah. "Par *use* chot — wo cheez hai jo princess *tum* mein nahi sah paayegi. Chhadi lo, ya main use aise aadmi ko dunga jo maza lega, aur chalis kar denge."
Wahi hisaab jo pehli raat se tumhara malik hai. Tumhare haath se bees waar, jitne naram himmat ho — ya kisi aur se kahin badtar.
Tum chhadi lete ho, haath kampata. Nessa mudkar chehra dhundhti hai, aur jab samajhti hai, cheekhti nahi. Sthir ho jati hai.

"Theek hai," wo aansuon mein kehti hai. "Maine chetavani khodi. Janti hoon tum nahi ho, jaise uske saath bhi tum kabhi nahi the. Tumhara haath unke se better. Karo. Main bees sah sakti hoon." Wo chehra phir khambe ki taraf modti hai aur kandhe jamati aur intezaar karti — unnis saal ki, jitni himmat kabhi na chahiye thi usse zyada.
Tum pehla waar jitna halka himmat ho karte ho — phir bhi padta hai, aur aag ki patli rekha peeth par khilti hai. "Ek," Vance ginta hai.
Tum khud ko doosra, teesra karne majboor karte ho. Paanchve tak wo khuleaam ro rahi; aathve tak cheekhen chhoti anchaahe vinti ban chuki — tumhe nahi, sirf shareer duniya se rukne ki bheekh.

Aadhe raaste wo phir aankhen dhundhti hai, bahti, aur phir bhi kuch thaamne ko dene ki koshish. "Chalte raho," wo hanfti hai. "Tumse poore bees better *uske* ek aur minute se. Mere saath raho. Mere saath gino."
Tum sir mein uske saath ginte ho, baarah, terah, chaudah, har sankhya ek chhoti private maafi jo kabhi kaafi nahi. Vance shant dhyan se dekhta hai jaise koi theory pakka kar raha ho.

Bees par tum chhadi girate ho aur faisla karne se pehle khambe par ho, use thaamte jaise bahon mein dhalti hai. Kampti, phooli, par zinda aur hosh mein, aur pehli cheez jo karti hai asteen jakadna. "Dekha? Bees. Kaha tha. Hum theek hain."
"Chhu lene wala," Vance kehta hai, chhadi wapas leta. "Use wapas le jao," wo sipahiyon se kehta hai, aur darwaza us par band hota hai, tumhe superintendent aur aage ke lambe raaste ke saath chhodta.
"Ab," Vance kehta hai, coat jhaadta. "Princess ke paas neeche. Batao kya kiya, koi detail mat bachao — main pahredaron se poochhunga. Aur phir bheekh mango."

"Iska shape samjho. Aaj bees waar the. Kal badtar, har din chadhta, jab tak ya to Everspring de ya hafta khatm aur hum phir bhi phansi den. Tumhare paas chheh din hain kisi jaan bachane ko manane ke. Salah hai impressive bano."
Saat seedhiyan kabhi itni lambi nahi lagi. Elara tumhare jooton par sir uthati hai, phir chehra dekhti hai, khoon jo tumhara nahi, aur bhaav badalta hai. "Unhone kya kiya," wo kehti hai. Sawal nahi.
To tum ghutne tekte ho aur batate ho. Nessa ke baare mein, khamba, chhadi, bees waar jo khud ke haath ne diye. Har shabd uske upar alag chot ki tarah girta dekhte ho.

Jab khatm karte ho, Elara khamosh hai, phir bahut dheemi aur sthir: "To yahi uska khel hai. Mere shareer se nahi tod saka, to tumhare se todega. Uski se." Aankhen band. "Mere apne maans ke liye koi yaatna nahi jo wo soch chhue jitna ki wo ladki chhadi ke neeche meri khamoshi ki wajah se."
Wo aankhen kholti hai, geeli aur tez. "Ab tum bheekh mangoge. Usne kaha. To mango. Khatm karo."
Aur tum nahi kar sakte. Sach mein bheekh mangna use duniya ke sabse cruel aadmi ko amar rehne ki taakat thamaana kehna hai, aur dar se better koi hissa muh se wo vinti nahi banne deta.

"Nahi kar sakta," tum bajaye fusfusate ho. "Maine *use* dekha hai. Agar aisa aadmi kabhi na mare— par wo meri behen hai, unnis ki, aur mujhe *nahi* pata kya karun. Poori zindagi pehli baar nahi pata kya karun." Tum sir jhukate ho, aur ek bada aadmi dungeon ke floor par toot jata hai.

Elara jitna bandhan dete hain aage jhukti hai, awaaz us kali jagah ki sabse naram cheez. "Tum bheekh nahi mangoge, aur main nahi tootungi — aaj nahi. Hum is aadmi se chalaak hain, aur chheh mein se pehle din ghabrakar jeetne nahi denge."

"Chheh din," wo fusfusati hai. "Usne chheh din diye teesra raasta dhundhne — jo na meri khamoshi use maare na mera raaz duniya ko shaapit kare. Hamesha teesra raasta hota hai. Dhundhne mein madad karo."
Tum us raat seedhiyan chadhte ho kuch hal nahi, aur peeche andhere mein, pehli baar, princess marne ka intezaar nahi kar rahi. Wo plan banana shuru kar rahi hai.
— Adhyay 11 samaapt —

Doosra din. Wo mashalein badalne se pehle aaye, aur Elara ki kothri nahi — nange kamre mein, floor mein naali aur lambi lohe ki naand itne thande paani se bhari ki kinaron par barf jam gayi. Vance pehle se wahan tha. Uske paas stool se bandhi, usi phate kapde mein, Nessa.
Unnis saal ki, kalaiyan peeche bandhi, hoth is thand ki raat se pehle hi dhoosar-neele, aankhen tumhari dhundhti us aatank ke saath jo tumhare liye nigalne ki itni koshish karti.
"Accha. Bhai." Vance barfiili surface par do ungliyan pherita. "Thand magistrate ko dikhane kuch nahi chhodti aur bhai ko yaad rakhne sab."

"Tum use dubaaoge. Main nahi. Tum. Har baar main sawal poochhun aur khamoshi pasand na aaye, uska chehra paani mein, aur tum das ginte rehna jab wo thodi doobe. Aur jab sah na sako, apni princess ko batane jaoge behen sukhana iklauta tarika hai Everspring kahan hai batana."
"Mujhe nahi pata kahan hai. Main pahredar hoon," tumne kaha.
"Beshak nahi. Main tumse nahi poochh raha — *istemaal* kar raha hoon. Wo tumhe isse bachane baat karegi." Usne naand ki taraf ishara kiya. "Shuru karo."
Kamre mein do aur aadmi khade the. Tum bimaar spashtata se samajh gaye, agar mana kiya, wo karenge, aur das nahi ginenge.

To tum behen ke peeche ghutne teke aur patle kandhon par haath rakhe. "Nessa," tum saans mein. "Jab dabaaun saans rok. Upar laaunga. Kasam." Usne sir hilaya — ek chhoti, kampti haan — aur wo tumhare andar kuch toot gaya jo tab se juda nahi.
"Everspring kahan hai?" Vance ne khaali hawa se poocha. Khamoshi. "Neeche."
Tumne apni behen ka chehra barf-paani mein dhakela aur gina jab wo tadapti, hanfti zinda upar khinchi, aur Vance ne phir kaha, aur tumne phir kiya.

Chaar baar. Paanch. Tum bhool gaye kitni baar bachi iklauti khoon ko dubaya aur wapas laya. Beech mein wo tumhara naam sisakti — kabhi dosh mein nahi, wo asahaniya tha — jaise bachcha us ek insan se kahe jo rukwane wala mana jata hai ki please rukwa do.
"Subah ke liye kaafi," Vance ne aakhir kaha, ubaa. "Neeche jao. Bheekh mango. Jab samajhdar hone ko taiyar ho tab lautna."
Unhone Nessa ko wapas ghasitne se pehle tumhare coat mein lapetne diya — jitni daya jeet sake. Phir Elara ke andhere ki taraf chale, asteenen bheegi, na jaante kaise kahoge.
Usne bolne se pehle paani suna, jaise hamesha. "Tum geele ho," wo shant boli. "Unhone kya karwaya."
Aur tumne bataya — naand, barf, apne haath, Nessa tumhara naam kehti. Wo sirf tumhari awaaz se le saki, jo apni cruelty hai. Tumne mehsoos kiya chains mein wo bahut shant ho gayi jaise bole.

"Wo use yaatna nahi de raha," usne aakhir kaha, dheemi aur samajh se bhayaanak. "*Tumhe* yaatna de raha. Uske zariye, mere zariye — yantra baja raha wo sur dhundhne ko jo mera muh khole. Wo bahut accha hai. To hum aise ladna band karte hain. Ab se, wo ek cheez karte hain jiski wo nigraani nahi kar raha."
"Kaun si cheez," tumne kaha.
"Hum *dekhna* shuru karte hain. Chheh din — wo todne ke liye kehta rehta. Main use karungi. Har baar wo tumhe todne neeche bheje, tum mujhe kamra laaoge."

"Jab in galiyaron mein chalo, toota aadmi bheekh mangta — use yakeen rehne do. Par bheekh mangte *gino.* Pahre ki badli par seedhi ke pahredar. Mashalein kab badalti aur chaabiyan kaun le jata. Thandi hawa kahan se aati — bahar ka raasta, hamesha. Upar ki beam par rassi, us nange kamre ki naali, darwaza jo wo kabhi poora band nahi karte."

"Abhi kuch plan mat. Bas kamra laao, tukde-tukde, jab tak main andhere mein chal sakun. Raat ki badli par pahredar gino. Kal wo laao. Hamare paas chheh din hain, aur main unhe shok mein kharch karna band kar chuki."
Tum us raat seedhi chadhe asteenen abhi bheegi — par pehli baar, ginte. Nichli landing par do pahredar, upri par ek, teesri pahredari par mashal-wahak baayi kamar par chaabiyan.
Chhoti cheezein. Kuch nahi cheezein. Sab kuch ki shuruaat. Chheh mein se doosra din khatm — chaar aur, aur ek sipahi jisne aakhir, chupchaap, jeetne ka faisla kar liya.
— Adhyay 12 samaapt —

Naand ke baad ke din ek dhoosar dard mein ghul gaye. Vance ka lever — chhadi, thand, bheekh ka chakra — kaam nahi kar raha tha. Chauthe din raja ne poore design se dhairya khoya: khabar aayi Nessa table se hata di gayi, sadharan kothri mein, khilai, bina chhue.

Iska matlab tumhare gale ki rassi bhi dheeli pad gayi. Un dhundhli raaton mein tum Elara ko kamra laate rahe, tukde-tukde — pahre ki badli, chaabiyan, eent band naali se thandi hawa — jab tak bhagna almost taiyar na ho.
Phir unhone bataya phansi bhor ko tay hai — aur aaj raat, raja khud aakhri baar poochhne neeche aa raha hai.

Raja Mordane bina dhoomdhaam aaya — lamba, bina jaldbaazi ka aadmi saade oon mein, kandhe par jadugar, chaar sipahi kapde ke neeche kuch bhaari uthaye. Thaka clerk lagta tha. Wahi uske baare mein sabse darawna tha.
"To yahi hai," wo bola, chains mein Elara ko parakhta. "Kahaniyon se chhoti." Aankhen tum par gayin. "Aur yahi hai jo us par fida ho gaya. Ruko. Mujhe gawah chahiye jo mehsoos kare."
Sipahiyon ne kapda hataya — kale lohe ka ghumawdar frame, chaap cruel shikhar tak. Palna, agar palna us cheez ko todne ke liye bana ho jise thaame.

"Patti utaro," raja bola. "Main chahta hoon wo apne raja ko samajhdar dekhe." Aur tumse: "Use is par litane mein madad karo. Kaha gaya tumhare haath naram hain. Istemaal karo. Yeh aakhri narmi hogi jo kisi se milegi."

Unhone tumhe majboor kiya uski kamar lohe ke shikhar par rakho, kalaiyan ek taraf, takhne doosri, jab tak poora shareer ghumaw par peeche na mud jaye. Usne koi awaaz nahi ki — sirf aankhen dhundhin aur thaamin: tumhari galti nahi, hum khatm nahi.
Phir sipahiyon ne cuffs se wazan taange, chaap gehra hua, aur chhati par aadhe bhare chaabuk ke nishan phat gaye, taaza khoon lohe mein bahta. Wo hanfi, pehli awaaz, daanton ke beech.

Raja jhuka, aur chhoti mitti ki jar nikali. "Namak aur sirka," usne kaha, tumhe thamate. "Sabse naram haath tumhare, to tumhare hone chahiye. Mana karo, to jadugar karega, aur tum uske saath kode khaoge. Jaldi chuno."

To tumhare haathon ne namak aur sirka uski chhati ki phati rekhaon mein daale, aur jo cheekh phati dungeon bhar gayi. Wo janti thi tum ho, aur phir bhi dosh nahi diya. "Everspring kahan hai, Elara?" raja cheekhon par poocha, jaise koi ghanta pooche.

Wo lohe par royi aur kampi, aur jab shabd bana saki, wo wo nahi the jo wo chahta. "Tumhe mujhse kuch nahi milega, clerk-raja. Jharna mere saath marta hai. Jo aadmi hamesha jeena chahe use *kabhi* ijazat nahi."
Mordane ke thake chehre par kuch chamka — gussa nahi. Almost samman. Gusse se bura tha.

Raja gusse mein nahi phoota. Sir hilaya, jaise usne kuch pakka kiya, aur jar phir tumhare haathon mein dabaya. "Phir, gehra. Aur meri peshkash suno, princess — ek baar. Ek shabd aur bhor ki phansi nahi. Shant kamra, khidki, behen Liora hamesha safe. Bolo, aur dono saans lete bahar chalo."
"Dalo," usne dheere kaha. "Use namak mein sochne do."

To tumne phir dala, aur wo phir cheekhi, muda shareer chains ke khilaaf marodata — aur phir, aur phir. "Everspring kahan hai?" Chhu. Cheekh. "Liora, safe. Ek zindagi." Chhu. Cheekh. Usne kabhi awaaz nahi uthayi, yakeen ki har koi tootta hai agar tum kaafi shant raho.

Tum wahan khade aurat mein peeda daalte jisse pyaar karte ho kyunki option jadugar ke cruel haath aur uske paas frame tha. Aur wo nahi tooti — na namak ke liye, na zindagi ki peshkash ke liye, na raja ke muh mein Liora ke naam ke liye. Peeche mudi, chhati khuli, usne jharna nahi diya.
Raja seedha hua. "Aur wazan. Bade patthar. Kalaiyan aur takhnon dono par taango — chahta hoon reedh seekhe kisse bahas kar rahi hai."

Tum aur ek sipahi ne cuffs se khadaan-patthar taange, aur har ek ke saath chaap shareer ke bane se aage gehra hua, reedh khinchi twacha ke neeche khadi. Har ek par usne awaaz ki jo baaki zindagi sunoge.
Chaar patthar tange, raja ne khula haath uski tanti pet par rakha. "Tum phir kabhi na khade hone se ek ungli ki doori par ho, princess. Ek aur patthar, ya chaar shabd — *yeh hai* — aur naam."

"Ek," usne kaha. "Do." Aur *teen* par — jab tum paanchve patthar bahon mein jamaye jame the — usne saans khinchi aur dhaage jaisi awaaz mein kaha: "Pehle... jala doongi." Uske dhairya mein kuch aakhir patla pada.

Wo khada hua, aur joote ka talwa uski nangi gardan par rakha — dheere, naapa, saans ki nali par dabav jab wo pin thi aur sir nahi ghuma sakti. Chehra gehra ho gaya; tum aadha kadam lapke isse pehle bhale ka danda chhati mein laga.

Bilkul kinare par, usne joota uthaya, ek phephde bharne diya, aur naram poocha: "Everspring kahan hai?" Usne nahi bola. Teen baar usne use andhere ke kinare tak le gaya aur teen baar usne saans ki jagah khamoshi di.

Raja pehle ruka, daya se nahi. Usne khaali jar tumhare haathon se li aur use achraj jaisi cheez se dekha. "Gyarah saal maine us paani ka shikar kiya, aur aakhri darwaza ek ladki jo kholne se pehle jal jayegi."
"Par main dhairyavaan hoon, aur ek raat bachi hai. Ise aise hi chhodo — patthar rahein, mod rahe. Aur nahi chahta wo soye. Basin lagao."
Unhone upar pinhole wala tambe ka basin taanga aur tumhe tapakta upar khinchne diya — thanda paani raat bhar uske upar muh aur kachche ghaavon par, bas itni baar ki neend mein nahi ja sake.

"Bhor tak," raja bola, pehli boondein girte dekh, "ya to jharna de ya shehar ko shant phansi. Dono kaam aate." Seedhi par rukkar, almost khud se: "Afsos. Yeh poore mahal mein iklauti imaandaar cheez thi."
Phir wo chala gaya. "Tumhara maksad poora, naram haath," Vance bola, tumhe seedhiyon ki taraf le jata jab do taaze pahredar duty lete. "Bhor ko wapas milegi, jo bache, rassi tak chalane ke liye."

Tum lambi seedhi chadhe basin ki tapak andhere mein peeche-peeche — joote mein aadhi kati chaabi aur neend ki dawa, aur do taaze pahredaron se paar pahunchne ka koi raasta nahi. Bhor phansi hai. Tum bhi nahi soye.
— Adhyay 13 samaapt —

Bhor dhoosar aur pakki aayi. Unhone use palne se utara — teen din bina neend aur raat peeche mude se wo mushkil se khadi ho pa rahi; reedh ek saath seedhi nahi hoti, har charan par awaaz faadti. Unhone aadhi ghasit use roshni mein nikala jo hafton nahi dekhi thi.
Poora shehar aaya tha, chauk kandhe se kandha thasa, aur jab wo aayi, palak jhapkaati aur tooti, jo awaaz unhone banayi insan ki nahi thi — das hazaar galon ki nafrat ki deewar.

Unhone use rassi ke neeche machaan par khada kiya. Raja Mordane ne ek haath uthaya aur chauk shant ho gaya. "Rajdhani ke log, is aurat se ek cheez mangi gayi jo jaan kharidti. Ek baar aur poochhunga, jahan sab sun saken." Wo uski taraf muda. "Everspring, Elara. Bolo, aur jiyo. Khamosh raho, aur ye acche log tumhe girte dekhein."

Usne sir uthaya, aur poore chauk ko apna barbaad chehra dikhaya. "Tumhara raja hamesha jeena chahta hai. Yahi raaz hai jiske liye usne teen hafte yaatna di. Suraksha nahi — *hamesha.* Khud poocho aisa aadmi hazaar saal mein kya karta hai." Wo dagmagayi, sambhali. "Main aaj marungi taaki wo na jee sake. Yeh tumhare bachchon ko ab tak ka sabse accha tohfa hai. Rassi khincho."

Yeh raja ke liye galat cheez thi. Bheed mein badbadaahat daudi — bechaini ki jhalak, das hazaar saron mein sawal: *hamesha?* Wo bardasht nahi kar sakta tha rassi us shabd hawa mein latke shaheed bana de.
"Nahi," usne kaha, haath neeche. "Jaldi girna usne jo kamaya uske liye bahut saaf hai. Aaj wo *tumhe* jawab degi."
Unhe use machaan ke kinare pillory mein band kiya — bhaari oak frame gardan aur kalaiyan jakadta, aage jhuki bebas.

"Teen hafte mere poochhtachh karne walon ke paas rahi, kuch nahi mila," raja pukara. "Shayad jinka nuksaan kiya wo better karein. Shaam tak yahan khadi rahe. Sirf mare nahi — phansi meri hai, jab chunun."
Usne tumhe aur pahredaron ki qatar pillory ke paaye par lagayi — uski raksha nahi, apni property ki. Tumhare orders: bheed ko maarne se roko, aur uske alawa sab karne do.
To tum us aurat aur shehar ke beech khade rahe jo use marta chahta, talwar sirf badtar maut ke liye zinda rakhne ki ijazat.

Wo baadh mein aaye — sada phal, gandagi, thook — poora shehar nafrat us aurat par khaali karta jo aankhen ponchhne haath bhi nahi utha sakti. Ek boodhe ne switch se chehre par mara jab tak pahredar peeche na dhakelen.
Kuch ne yeh kamaya tha — aurat rote hue phenkti, aadmi har patthar par bete ka naam. Elara ne unke khet jalaye the. Us chauk mein shok asli tha, aur khade hone ki koi saaf jagah nahi.

Dopahar tak ek aurat kainchi lekar chadhi aur garjan mein baal kaat diye; keechad mein gire aur raunde gaye. Phenke patthar ne maatha khola aur khoon aankhon mein bahta jo ponchh nahi sakti — aur phir bhi, har ghante, jakda sir oak jitna upar uthati aur unka saamna karti, aur unke liye nahi roti, aur bheekh nahi mangti.

Do baar, aadmiyon ne maarne wale patthar phenke. Dono baar tum bina faisla kiye hil gaye — shield ne ek liya, doosre ka baaju kaat diya. Usne mehsoos kiya. Ek baar, jab kaafi paas the, phate hothon se do shabd saans mein, sirf tumhare liye: "Abhi nahi." Keh rahi thi thaame raho — das hazaar gawahon ke saamne bachane sab barbaad mat karo.
Yeh tab tak chala jab roshni amber ho gayi aur bheed ka baaju thak gaya. Shaam tak chauk khaali ho raha tha, aur pillory mein jo bacha mushkil se hilta.

Vance use kholne aaya. "Abhi saans le rahi," usne note kiya, barbaad chehra thuddi se uthata. "Raja ne rassi ke liye naya din nahi tay kiya. Jab tootogi tab phansi, pehle nahi. Kal ho sakta hai. Lamba, bahut lamba waqt ho sakta hai."

Unhe use andhere mein le gaye, aur tum wahi the jisne gandagi aur khoon dhoye, haath kamapte. Tum dono ne nahi kaha jo dono ab jaante: phansi ki tareekh nahi bachi *pehle* bhagne ko — sirf khule dinon ka failav jismein raja chot pahunchayega jab tak mar na jaye, koi schedule nahi sirf uska dhairya.
Jis ghadi se tum daud rahe the gayi. Aur bina deadline ka aadmi perfect raat ka intezaar band karta hai, aur ek banana shuru karta hai.

Wo us raat aakhir soyi, shareer ki mari neend jismein kuch nahi bacha, nanga sir tumhari god mein, peeth kothri ke darwaje ki taraf — jabki tum jaage baithe pahredar ginte, pahre ki badli, eent naali ki thandi saans, aadhi kati chaabi ungliyon mein palatte.
Koi deadline nahi. Koi perfect raat nahi. Sirf ek princess jisne poore shehar ko sach kaha aur jee gayi, aur ek pahredar jiske paas intezaar ki wajahen aakhir, poori tarah, khatm ho gayin.
— Adhyay 14 samaapt —

Raja ke paas ab calendar nahi tha, aur isse wo badtar ho gaya. Din wo sadne deta, phir naya raasta dhundha: tumhari behen. "Darwaze ke peeche dard afwah hai," usne kaha. "Suraj mein dard lever hai. Wahan karenge jahan shehar dekhe wo chunti hai."
Unhone deewaron ke neeche khule maidan mein banaya: lakdi ka A-frame, shikhar par pulley-wheel, dono sire par phanda cuff wali ek rassi. Bheed pehle se jut rahi — wahi shehar jisne patthar mare.
Unhone *tumse* lagwaya. Vance tumhare sir par khada jab tumne behen ki kalaiyan bandhin, phir princess ki, aur rassi piroi, gaanth-gaanth seekhte cruelty kaise kaam karti hai.

Vance bheed ko showman ki tarah samjhata gaya. "Saada, aur sahi. Is taraf ladki kamzor. Princess mazboot, to mazboot ko kamzor ko dhone dete. Mahamahim par wazan taangte — jab tak thaame, ladki aaram se khadi. Jis pal princess dhalti, ladki bandhe baazuon se zameen se upar khinchi jati jab tak kandhe jagah chhod den. Princess apni taakat se tay karti hai bachchi ko chot lage ya nahi."

Phir unhone use load kiya — kalai cuff par lohe ki salaakh par salaakh, baaju upar-peeche khinchte jab tak wo bhi ek dheemi janwar jaisi awaaz na kare. Minuton mein kandhon ki twacha gehari, gussail laal ho gayi, khoon phansa aur dhadakta jahan rassiyan kaatti.
Nessa, khud ko sthir rakhne itni kamzor, baar-baar jhukti; har baar dagmagati khinchav princess ko panjon par khinchta, kandhe cheekhte, jab tak eddi phir neeche laakar dono sthir na kare.

"Sthir raho, Nessa," Elara khaali jagah paar saans mein. "Lado mat, jaan. Main tumhe thaame hoon. Khadi raho, aur mujhe dono thaamne do." Tumhari behen royi aur koshish ki, aur har nakami princess baazuon mein chukai — aur ek baar bhi rassi use girne nahi di.
Raja dekhta raha, asantusht — thaamna todna nahi. "Vance. Girne ki wajah do, aur dekhein apni twacha bachane ladki girati hai ya nahi. Chaabuk maro."

Vance ke chehre par cruelty se buri cheez jali — kritagyata. Yahan kripa mein wapsi ka raasta tha, aur wo princess ke shareer par se jata. "Tumne mujhe bahut keemat chukai, Mahamahim," wo dheere bola. "Kuch lautane do."

Pehla chaabuk chhati par gira, aadhe bhare nishanon par, phir nanga. Par asli cruelty jo mangta: agar hichke aur baaju ek hatheli bhi gire, Nessa zameen se phat jayegi. To hichak nahi sakti — har waar mari sthir khadi sahna, chaabuk us shareer mein sokhna jise hilne mana.
